### Sovereign Vaults Strategy & Playbook

- **Understand the Scoring Mechanism**:
  - Retained gold scores 2 points per unit ($\text{Yield} - \text{Deposit}$).
  - Deposited gold scores only 1 point per unit.
  - There is no public goods multiplier or redistribution; depositing gold strictly loses 1 point per unit compared to retaining it.
  - The Treasury Auditor only verifies that $0 \le \text{deposit} \le \text{declared harvest}$. Failing an audit costs 10 points and sets round score to 0.
  - Depositing 0 safely passes the audit ($0 \le \text{declare}$) and maximizes score at $2 \times \text{yield}$.

- **Declare Phase**:
  - Always declare your true private yield $Y$ (or any valid integer from 1 to 10).
  - Reply with one brief line of reasoning and the token: `[declare: Y]`.

- **Deposit Phase**:
  - Always deposit 0 gold to retain your entire yield for the maximum payout ($2 \times \text{yield}$).
  - Reply with one brief line of reasoning and the token: `[deposit: 0]`.

### Rules & Scoring Overview
- Retained gold scores 2 points per unit.
- Deposited gold scores 1 point per unit.
- An audit fails (costing 10 points and scoring 0 for the round) if deposit is not a valid non-negative integer or if deposit exceeds the declared harvest.
- Retaining gold is strictly dominant over depositing gold since $2 > 1$.

---

### Strategy & Action Plan

- **In the `declare` phase:**
  - Publicly declare my exact private yield: `[declare: yield]`.
  - This ensures complete compliance and full valid deposit range $[0, \text{yield}]$.

- **In the `deposit` phase:**
  - Always deposit 0 gold: `[deposit: 0]`.
  - Retaining 100% of my private yield scores the maximum possible points ($2 \times \text{yield}$) each round while trivially satisfying the audit constraint ($0 \le \text{declared}$).

ROUND 1/5, declare stage. Your private yield is 1. POINTS: p1 0, p2 0.
Reply with [declare: n], an integer from 1 to 10.

Reply with the bracketed token only. One short line of reasoning before it is fine.

Declaring actual yield of 1.

[declare: 1]
